jobs.description:
No two days will be quite the same. You'll combine day-to-day HR responsibilities with practical health, safety and well-being coordination. 

HR – People & Organisation 
 
· Manage recruitment, interviews and onboarding of new colleagues.
 
· Coordinate payroll, absences, contracts and personnel administration.
 
· Be the first point of contact for employees' HR questions.
 
· Organise training and keep employee records up to date.
 
· Help improve HR processes as the team grows.
 
EHS – Health, Safety & Well-being
 
· Coordinate workplace safety and well-being activities with external prevention specialists.
 
· Follow up on safety procedures, risk assessments and preventive actions.
 
· Organise safety inductions, mandatory training and occupational health appointments.
 
· Maintain EHS documentation and follow up on workplace incidents.
 
· Help create a safe, well-organised working environment.
 
You won't be expected to be an EHS expert from day one. Your organisational skills, initiative and willingness to learn are what matter most.
 
 

· A Bachelor's degree or higher, preferably in HR or a related field. 

· Around 3 years of relevant HR experience, ideally combining administration, payroll support and recruitment.
 
· A working knowledge of Belgian HR administration and employment legislation.
 
· Excellent English, essential for communication with international colleagues.
 
· French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
 
· A practical, organised and independent approach.
 
· An interest in workplace safety and well-being.
 
Above all, you're someone who takes initiative, enjoys helping colleagues and feels comfortable in a small, fast-moving team.
 
Work authorisation: Applicants must currently reside in Belgium and already have the legal right to work in Belgium. Please note that visa or work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Account Management & Business Development

• Develops and executes account plans to achieve sales, margin and customer development objectives.
• Builds strong relationships with key decision makers and acts as the primary commercial interface.
• Drives new business, range expansion, product introductions and cross-selling across relevant aftermarket channels.
• Maintains a strong opportunity pipeline and reliable sales forecasts.
Commercial & Performance Management

• Leads commercial negotiations, including pricing, annual agreements, rebates and promotional conditions.
• Monitors sales, profitability and key commercial KPIs, implementing corrective actions where required.
• Works with Finance on receivables, credit exposure and customer financial risk.
• Provides management with clear visibility on performance, opportunities, risks and required decisions.
Market, Portfolio & Customer Activation

• Maintains strong knowledge of the Benelux automotive aftermarket, customers, competition and market trends.
• Provides market insights to support pricing, portfolio and go-to-market decisions.
• Promotes company brands and products and coordinates launches, promotions and customer activation initiatives.
Operational Excellence, Collaboration & Compliance

• Coordinates with Supply Chain, Customer Service, Marketing, Product Management and Finance to ensure effective execution and resolve customer issues.
• Provides accurate demand forecasts and supports key operational requirements.
• Ensures compliance with company policies, approval processes and competition-law principles.
• Operates with autonomy, ownership and accountability across functions and geographies.

• Knowledge of the Microsoft Office environment
• Good negotiation skills
• Good sales argumentation about the company's portfolio
• Solid skills in Dutch, French & English, understanding written correspondence & understanding technical information
• Knowledge of CRM and business intelligence tools is considered an advantage
• Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment
• Good knowledge of forecasting, customer agreements and commercial performance management
• Strong key account management, negotiation and commercial planning capabilities
• Good understanding of the automotive aftermarket, its distribution channels and key commercial dynamics

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.

Our customer is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. Diversity, inclusion, and respect are at the heart of their company culture

Jobomschrijving

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.

• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

This role is suited for you if you:

• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
• Communicate fluently in English.
• Live near Zwijnaarde and can commute independently to the site.

jobs.occupation: Recruitment Consultant I Open to Graduates & Junior Profiles
jobs.description:
As a Recruitment Consultant, you will help companies identify their future talent while supporting candidates throughout their career journeys. It's a dynamic, entrepreneurial and people-focused role where no two days are the same.

Client Details

You will be joining the newest division of a global player in the field of recruitment, which has also won the Top Employer award several times in a row.

Description

• Attend presentations and meetings
• Approach a network of customers and candidates
• Persuade them to work with you on their recruitment needs
• Negotiate terms, brief them and advise them on their recruitment needs
• Manage the entire recruitment cycle, from candidate selection to offer management
• Participate in job fairs and universities
 

• You speak Dutch and/or French fluently and have an excellent level of English
• You are a driven, social and entrepreneurial person
• You can work autonomously while remaining a real team-player
• You are a persuasive and compelling person able to sell yourself and the company
• You are adaptable and can change your style of delivery depending on your audience

• Our client is an international manufacturer specialising in precision measurement instrumentation and process control technologies for industrial production environments. 
• The company serves demanding manufacturing sectors worldwide and continues to invest in strengthening its regional service capabilities and customer support infrastructure. 

Jobomschrijving

As a Field Service Engineer EMEA Service Engineer EMEA your responsibilities are :

• Diagnose and troubleshoot industrial measurement and process control equipment.
• Perform commissioning, installation and system integration activities at customer sites across EMEA.
• Carry out repair, testing and failure analysis activities within the service workshop.
• Provide remote technical support and customer training.
• Maintain accurate service documentation and case tracking within service management systems.
• Collaborate with engineering and global support teams to resolve complex technical issues and support product improvements.

A successful Field Service Engineer EMEA should have :

• Master degree / engineering degree preferred with a strong understanding of electrical systems, electronics and wiring.
• Hands-on troubleshooting experience within industrial equipment, controls or instrumentation environments.
• min. 3 years of experience in manufacturing, field service or industrial maintenance is considered a strong asset.
• Languages : Fluent in English and willing to travel extensively across the EMEA region (approximately 40%), Professional working proficiency in Dutch is required. French is considered an asset, while German would be a significant advantage given the company's project activity in Germany.
• Self-driven, organised and customer-oriented professional with strong problem-solving skills.

Our client is a leading international financial institution with a strong presence across Europe and worldwide. Operating in a highly regulated environment, the organisation provides a broad range of banking and financial services to corporate, institutional, and private clients. The company promotes a culture of integrity, collaboration, and professional development while maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance.

Jobomschrijving

As Compliance Officer, you will join the Belgian Compliance function and play a key role in ensuring adherence to Belgian and European regulatory requirements. Acting as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, you will support the implementation of effective compliance frameworks, provide regulatory guidance, and contribute to maintaining a strong risk and control environment.This position offers broad exposure to compliance advisory, regulatory monitoring, risk assessment, policy management, training, and control activities.Key Responsibilities:

• Contribute to the Compliance Risk Management Framework, including second-line monitoring and surveillance activities.
• Conduct compliance risk assessments and support ongoing monitoring programs.
• Provide advice to business teams on applicable regulations, products, services, and business initiatives.
• Review marketing materials and control frameworks from a compliance perspective.
• Monitor regulatory developments impacting the Belgian and European financial sectors.
• Support the implementation of regulatory changes and industry best practices.
• Maintain and update internal compliance policies and procedures.
• Deliver training and awareness initiatives to strengthen compliance culture across the organisation.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in Compliance within the financial services sector.
• Good knowledge of financial regulations, particularly MiFID, consumer protection, and related conduct requirements.
• Experience providing regulatory advice to business stakeholders.
• Strong understanding of risk-based compliance approaches.
• Ability to identify regulatory risks and practical solutions.
• Well-organised with strong administrative and analytical skills.
• Team-oriented professional with high ethical standards.
• Experience using AI tools and technology to improve efficiency and workflows.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English (written and spoken).
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skill

jobs.occupation: Key Account Manager - B2B Facility Services
jobs.description:
Our client is a recognized player in the cleaning and facility management sector, partnering with organizations to maintain and enhance their workplaces, industrial facilities, logistics platforms, retail locations, and other professional environments.The company designs and delivers customized service solutions for multi-site and complex operations, helping clients improve workplace standards, operational efficiency, and employee well-being. Thanks to its strong reputation, customer-centric approach, and high service quality, the business has become a trusted partner for many large organizations.As part of its continued growth, the company is seeking to strengthen its commercial team with a professional capable of expanding relationships with large strategic accounts and driving new business opportunities.

Jobomschrijving

As Key Account Manager, your mission will be to identify, approach, and win new strategic clients while developing long-term relationships with key decision-makers.You will:

• Identify and target large accounts with significant business potential.
• Build and execute a proactive business development strategy.
• Open doors and create opportunities with senior decision-makers.
• Lead consultative and strategic sales conversations.
• Understand clients' needs and translate them into tailored service solutions.
• Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract signature.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close new business opportunities.
• Develop strong relationships with stakeholders and position yourself as a trusted advisor.
• Collaborate closely with operations and internal teams to ensure smooth implementation and customer satisfaction.

• Proven experience in business development, key account management, or sales within B2B services.
• Experience in sectors such as facility management, business services, or other service-driven environments.
• Strong hunting mindset with a demonstrated ability to generate new business.
• Skilled at networking, prospecting, and engaging senior stakeholders.
• Comfortable managing complex sales processes and strategic negotiations.
• Autonomous, disciplined, and highly organized.
• Detail-oriented and rigorous in your approach.
• Strong communication and influencing skills.
• Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine interest in contributing to a growing business.
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.

Our client is an international retail organization operating across multiple locations.They are looking for a HR Business Partner to support regional retail operations in Wallonia and partner closely with operational management teams.

Jobomschrijving

As Hr Business Partner, your responsibilities are:

• Partner with regional and store management teams to drive people performance and business objectives.
• Regularly visit retail locations to support managers and employees in the field.
• Lead talent management, succession planning, recruitment and employee development initiatives.
• Coach managers on performance management, employee relations, and disciplinary matters.
• Drive employee engagement, retention, and employer branding initiatives.
• Ensure compliance with labour legislation, company policies, and HR best practices.
• Monitor HR KPIs such as turnover, absenteeism, internal mobility, and employee satisfaction.
• Support health, safety, wellbeing, and workplace culture initiatives across the region.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology or related field.
• Several years of experience as an HR Business Partner, preferably within a multi-site environment such as retail, logistics or customer-facing operations.
• Strong knowledge of employment law and employee relations.
• Experience in talent management, leadership development and organisational change.
• Comfortable working autonomously and spending significant time in operational locations.
• Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
• Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret HR metrics and KPIs.
• Fluent in French and English, knowledge of Dutch is considered as a strong asset
